research_question: Do typed case-adaptive workflows preserve gateway invariants and replay under matched providers and call caps?
hypothesis: All workflows preserve mandatory gateway invariants; adaptive routing changes executed operators with evidence availability.
decision_informed: Engineering readiness of MedX workflow integration, not clinical efficacy

training.checkpoint_policy: No checkpoints; this is an evaluation of deterministic behaviour

fixed_factors: 8 tools per run; 30 per case; 20 turns
comparisons.fairness_notes: No training. One draft model call per completed run. Optional tool counts differ and are measured. Token usage reported when provided; no claim of matched token usage. All six designs declared before runs; no heldout selection.

evaluation.statistics_plan: Descriptive synthetic software invariants only; 20 patients, two timepoints each. No clinical thresholds or statistical superiority claims.
exclusion_rules: No case may be excluded after its result is seen

stop_rules: Stop external run at configured budget; preserve failures. Invalidate readiness if temporal or safety floor checks fail.

artifacts.retention: Retain with the Proposal Report evidence
